title: Integrate Bluefire Cysec PNG logo into Navbar and Footer

requirements.text: Save the uploaded Bluefire Cysec logo image as a static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/bluefire-logo.png and use it as the logo image in the Navbar component, replacing any existing text-based or placeholder logo.

quotes: en el header/navbar y en el footer

acceptanceCriteria: The Bluefire Cysec PNG logo is displayed in the Navbar/header.
The logo image is served from frontend/public/assets/generated/bluefire-logo.png.
The logo is appropriately sized for the navbar (e.g., height ~40–48px) and does not overflow the navbar height.
The logo is visible against the navbar background.

requirements.text: Use the same Bluefire Cysec PNG logo (frontend/public/assets/generated/bluefire-logo.png) in the Footer component, replacing any existing text-based or placeholder logo.

quotes: en el header/navbar y en el footer

acceptanceCriteria: The Bluefire Cysec PNG logo is displayed in the Footer.
The footer logo uses the same image file as the navbar logo.
The logo is appropriately sized for the footer context (e.g., height ~40–56px).
The logo is visible against the footer background.

constraints: Use the uploaded image as a PNG file; do not convert it to SVG or recreate it as a component.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/main.tsx.
nonGoals: Redesigning the Navbar or Footer layout beyond logo placement.
Adding the logo to any other section (hero, services, etc.).
Converting the logo to SVG or applying transparency treatments.

required: Bluefire Cysec brand logo: dark navy blue shield with blue flame and red network node overlay, 'Bluefire' in bold dark navy text and 'CYSEC' in bold red text on white background (bluefire-logo.dim_600x200.png)
